description: This file defines the interface and factory for the Control component within the Rialto client namespace. It includes class declarations for Control and ControlFactory, which are responsible for creating and managing control clients and their interactions with the client controller.

classes.name: ControlFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating Control instances, implementing the IControlFactory interface.

classes.name: Control
classes.description: Implementation of the IControl interface, managing control clients and interacting with the client controller.

methods.name: createControl
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IControl instance.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a ControlFactory instance.

methods.name: registerClient
methods.description: Registers a control client with the control instance, associating it with the application state.
